workItem: Add one bounded manual read-only security posture workflow, harden GitHub/Render/Supabase security evidence, converge the canonical Render deployment lane from the deleted deploy hook to the existing API credential, enforce a fail-closed Render preview/cleanup contract, and materialize the required 10-merge cadence PATCH 0.6.5.
workItemDE: Einen begrenzten manuellen Read-only-Security-Posture-Workflow ergänzen, GitHub-/Render-/Supabase-Security-Evidence härten, die kanonische Render-Deployment-Lane vom gelöschten Deploy Hook auf das bestehende API-Credential konvergieren, einen fail-closed Render-Preview-/Cleanup-Vertrag durchsetzen und den fälligen 10er-Cadence-PATCH 0.6.5 materialisieren.
scopeBoundary: Reuse the existing GitHub settings-inventory authority plus one bounded fixed-endpoint incident-evidence reader using the existing Enterprise Read secret; no second generic settings authority or raw REST proxy.
Posture workflow is workflow_dispatch-only, read-only and redacts secret/token/key values; missing provider permissions remain NOT_OBSERVABLE.
Render deployment stays in the existing CI deploy-production lane and uses the existing CAPITAL_AI_RENDER_API_KEY; no second deployment workflow or Render native auto-deploy.
No secret values are read into evidence, committed or logged. Secret checks are metadata/audit-event only.
SEC retains independent verification authority; this OPS slice implements affected runtime/deployment controls only.
Do not touch PR #1460 files server/logger.ts, src/platform/Security/edgeTrust.ts or tests/unit/edgeTrustTelemetryProductIntelligence.test.ts.
Render cleanup must verify missing allowlisted services through exact-ID provider reads or return NOT_OBSERVABLE/BLOCKED; list omission alone is never proof of deletion.

Finance PR previews may only be disabled after Human/CODEOWNER merge through the existing bounded Render Management workflow with exact service identity, exact confirmation and immediate after-readback.
Cadence PATCH 0.6.5 may only update the registered MERGE_CADENCE_PATCH_V1 allowlist through the existing Release Version Gate.
exitEvidence: Fresh CURRENT_MAIN is an ancestor of the exact branch head.
Focused tests cover the manual workflow contract, secret-value redaction, bounded incident-evidence projection, Render exact-commit API request and browser header contract.
Deployment chain no longer depends on RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL and still fails closed on stale main/incorrect deployment identity.
Manual posture workflow uses bounded read-only GitHub/Render/Supabase evidence and deletes temporary evidence/key files on every outcome.
No writer/file/semantic overlap remains before PR creation.
Human/CODEOWNER merge remains required; SEC runtime verification remains independent.
Render cleanup no longer reports PASS from list omission alone; exact-ID readback distinguishes PRESENT, ABSENT and NOT_OBSERVABLE.
Render preview contract is machine-tested and Finance converges to pullRequestPreviewsEnabled=no and previews.generation=off before the provider finding is closed.
package.json and package-lock.json plus governed version mirrors materialize exactly 0.6.5.
Production CI consolidation regression coverage asserts the exact-commit Render API trigger and rejects the retired deploy-hook ref=main expectation.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment.
